Definition
[Riemann curvature tensor via second covariant derivatives] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0299 ↗ appa-def-higher-covariant-derivatives 1. Equation A.6\group commuting-covariant-derivatives

The $(3,1)$-Riemann curvature tensor is defined by \[ R(X,Y)Z=( abla ^2 Z)(X,Y)-( abla ^2 Z)(Y,X) \] for all vector fields $X,Y,Z$.
